name: manager
description: Central bank manager agent that answers general bank inquiries and routes account-specific requests to deposit and loan agents via A2A.

skills.name: General Bank Information
skills.description: Answer customer questions regarding bank operating hours, branches, contact channels, and available financial services.
examples: How can I contact customer support?
What types of accounts do you offer?

skills.name: Account & Lending Routing
skills.description: Routes customer requests to specialized deposit or loan agents for secure processing.
examples: What is my balance on the vacation account?
When is my next auto payment due?
Can I get a loan for $10,000 for a car?
